app.name: Qirsh
app.tagline: Orders, money and stock for a solar distributor and its dealers
boot.title: Starting the demo
boot.subtitle: Postgres runs inside this tab, with the project's Supabase migrations.
boot.migrations: Running 8 migrations: tables, rules and row level security
boot.seed: Replaying about 100 days of business through the real functions (first visit only)
boot.locked: The demo is already open in another tab. Close it there, then reload this one.
signin.title: Choose who you are
signin.explain: In the real system every person signs in with their own email and password (Supabase Auth, with password reset and sessions that survive a weak connection). Here you pick a person; everything they see and can do is decided by the database, not by the screen.
signin.worked_example: The trial's worked example: sign in as Amira (adviser), open New order and tap “Fill in the worked example”. Line 3 is blocked; ask the owner, switch to Hamid (owner) to approve under Approvals, then switch back to Amira and save.
signin.distributor_note: The team of five in phase one. One environment, one set of books.
signin.dealer_note: Phase three, built in from day one: a separate environment with its own branding, users and data, sealed from the distributor's.
signin.disclaimer: All businesses, people, bank codes and amounts are invented. Every phone number is 0123456788. Data stays in this browser.
role.owner.can: Everything: prices, rates, users, margins, approvals, accounts and the books.
role.marketing.can: Reads customers, orders and stock; edits customers. Never sees a cost or a margin.
role.adviser.can: Orders and receipts for her own customers. Never sees a cost or a margin.
role.warehouse.can: Reads orders, receives shipments, releases paid orders. Sees no prices and no amounts.
nav.label: Main
shell.offline: No connection. You can keep working; saves wait on this phone.
shell.offline_pending: No connection. {n} saved on this phone, waiting to be sent.
order.title: New order
order.subtitle: Prices are fixed in dollars. Give a discount per line, enter today's rate, save.
order.worked.missing: The worked example's products aren't in this catalogue.
order.customer.search: Search your dealers by name, city or code
order.no_lines: Add the products the dealer asked for
order.line.bad_discount: Dollars and cents only, like 40 or 40.50
order.line.discount_too_big: The discount is larger than the line
order.blocked.title: Above 5%: the owner has to approve this line
order.blocked.explain: The order can't be saved while this line is blocked. Ask the owner, or lower the discount to 5% or less.
order.blocked.owner: As the owner, saving records your own approval on this line.
order.blocked.demo_hint: In the demo: Menu → Switch person → Hamid Osman (owner) → Approvals. Your order stays here as a draft.
order.approval.sent: Sent to the owner for approval.
order.rate.label: Today's rate
order.rate.hint: The minimum is {min}. Any higher rate is fine.
order.rate.refused: {typed} is below the minimum. The rate is back to {min}.
order.rate.stored: The rate is stored on the order. If the rate setting changes tomorrow, this order keeps these exact amounts.
order.queued: No connection: the order is saved on this phone and will be sent when the connection is back ({n} waiting). Sending twice is safe.
order.draft_kept: Your draft stays on this phone until it's saved, even if you close the app or lose the connection.
order.saved.title: Order {number} saved
order.saved.fixed: Stored at {rate} SDG per dollar. These amounts will never change.
pay.title: Payment instructions
pay.explain: Transfers of at most {max}, into accounts that still have room today.
pay.carry: {amount} doesn't fit into today's limits; it can be paid tomorrow.
pay.msg.screenshot: Please send a screenshot of each transfer. Thank you.
orderpage.not_found: This order doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
orderpage.no_payments: No payment matched to this order yet.
orderpage.fixed.title: Stored at {rate} SDG per dollar
orderpage.fixed.body: Every amount on this order was stored when it was saved. Today's minimum is {min}; that setting can't move this order.
orderpage.expired_rate: The quote's validity has passed. Enter today's rate (at least {min}); the dollar prices and discounts stay as quoted.
orderpage.wa_text: Hello {customer}, here is {number}: {usd}, which is {sdg} at {rate} SDG per dollar. Valid until {valid}.
orders.subtitle: Every order and quote, newest first.
orders.subtitle_adviser: Orders and quotes for your dealers.
approvals.subtitle: Discounts above 5% wait for your decision, line by line.
approvals.approved_toast: Approved. {name} can save the order now.
dash.dealer_env: This is a dealer's own environment (phase three). It has its own branding, users, customers and orders, and can't see the distributor's data, nor the distributor theirs. The dealer screens themselves come later.
dash.profit_note: Gross profit counts when goods leave the warehouse; the currency result when an exchanger pays out.
dash.todo.forward: {n} receipts not forwarded to the exchanger
dash.exchangers_note: Pounds received on their accounts and not yet paid out to us.
dash.accounts_today: Today's intake against the daily limit
pick.waiting: Not fully paid: can't leave yet
pick.confirm_body: These goods leave the warehouse for {customer}. The oldest stock goes first, and the release is recorded.
receipts.subtitle: Every transfer once, keyed on its bank transaction code, with its screenshot.
receipts.no_conflicts: No code has been recorded with two amounts.
receipts.resolution_hint: For example: amount misread on the second screenshot.
rec.subtitle: One screenshot, one transfer. Duplicates are refused; the same code with another amount is flagged.
rec.photo_add: Take a photo or choose the screenshot
rec.photo_note: It's made smaller on the phone before it's sent, and fingerprinted so the same screenshot can't be used twice.
rec.from_hint: Any spelling: Mogtaba, Mujtaba and Motgaba are recognised as one person.
rec.would_exceed: this transfer goes over the limit
rec.pays_none: No open orders for this dealer; the receipt stays unmatched for now.
rec.queued: No connection: saved on this phone, it will be sent when the connection is back.
rec.limit_note: This account is over its daily limit with this transfer. It will be saved and flagged; tell the dealer to use another account next time.
rec.rules: The database enforces these rules; the screen only helps.
rec.over_limit: It is flagged: the account is over its daily limit.
rec.next_forward: Next: forward it to the exchanger, so the money is known to be ours.
proof.generated: Drawn for the demo from the receipt's data, like the Arabic bank screenshots that arrive on WhatsApp. Screenshots you attach are shown as they are.
acc.subtitle: Every exchanger account, our own, pass-through and the UAE account, with live balances from the ledger.
acc.outstanding_note: Pounds on each exchanger's accounts that haven't been paid out to us yet.
acc.unconfirmed: Not yet confirmed by the exchanger: {amount}
acc.pass_not_zero: Should be zero: pass it on
acc.statement_diff: Exchanger's statement of {date} is off by
acc.payout_explain: Pounds an exchanger holds for us, paid out as euros or dirhams. They're settled against confirmed receipts, oldest first, and the currency result is recorded per order and per route.
acc.statement_explain: The balance the bank or exchanger reports. The closing checks compare it with the ledger on that date.
stock.subtitle: On hand, promised to confirmed orders, and on the way.
stock.adjust_explain: Takes units of {name} out of stock, oldest first, with the reason on record.
ship.subtitle: Purchases, from the supplier's invoice to the landed cost of each unit.
ship.wait_costs: The owner finalises the landed cost first, so every unit that can be sold already has a cost. Then it can go into stock.
ship.indirect_hint: {n} costs, each converted on the day it was paid
ship.uplift_hint: spread over the units by purchase value
ship.method: Indirect costs × (1 + {pct}%) are shared out in proportion to purchase value; the shares add up to the cent. The cost of a unit sold is fixed when it leaves the warehouse, oldest stock first.
ship.cost_rate_hint: Leave empty to use the day's reference rate.
cust.subtitle: {n} dealers and installers.
cust.not_found: This customer doesn't exist, or isn't yours.
cust.whatsapp_ready_body: Numbers are kept per contact with their opt-in, and every message is linked to this record, so the WhatsApp Business API (step 10) can plug in without changing the data.
cust.f.name: Name
profit.subtitle: {from} to {to}
profit.stable.title: These numbers never move
profit.stable.body: The report only adds up amounts that were stored, with their rates, when they happened: sales and landed cost when goods left, the currency result when an exchanger paid out. No rate is looked up while reporting, so last month reads the same today and in six months.
profit.how.title: How the currency result is made
profit.how.body: An order's pounds are worth its dollars at the order's own rate. When the exchanger pays them out as euros, what arrives is compared with that value, slice by slice. The difference lands on the order, its dealer, its adviser, its shipment and the exchanger's route.
profit.route_note: Currency result over the period, all routes: {amount}.
closing.subtitle_issues: {n} of {total} checks need a look. Contradictions are shown, never smoothed over.
closing.pass_through_zero.why: Money that passes through a relative's account must be passed on in full.
closing.statements_match: Ledger balances match the actual balances
closing.statements_match.why: Each account's ledger on the statement date equals what the bank or exchanger reports.
closing.forwarded: Receipts are forwarded to the exchanger
closing.forwarded.why: A transfer not forwarded within a day is money an exchanger doesn't know is ours.
closing.conflicts.why: The same transaction code recorded with a different amount waits for the owner.
closing.unmatched: Every receipt is matched to orders
closing.unmatched.why: Pounds received but not matched to an order can't be settled or reported.
closing.allocations_add_up.why: Each order's paid amount and each receipt's matched amount equal the sum of their slices.
closing.booked_add_up: Paid orders add up in dollars and euros
closing.booked_add_up.why: The dollar and euro value of every slice of a paid order adds up exactly to the order.
closing.released_add_up.why: Units, sales in dollars and in euros recorded at release equal the order.
closing.stock_add_up.why: Each lot's balance equals its recorded movements.
closing.released_paid.why: Every order that left the warehouse is fully paid.
closing.landed_add_up.why: Each shipment's line costs equal its purchase plus its uplifted costs.
closing.daily_limits: No account over its daily limit
closing.daily_limits.why: Transfers beyond an account's daily limit are kept but flagged.
price.subtitle: From the same catalogue as the orders, {date}.
settings.subtitle: Everything that differs per environment lives here, not in the code.
settings.saved: Saved. The change is on record.
settings.brand_note: Each environment has its own branding: the distributor's, and later each dealer's. The logo file goes to storage.
settings.min_rate_hint: Raise it as the pound falls. Saved orders keep their own rate.
settings.users_note: Personal logins only; each role is enforced in the database with row level security.
settings.kinds_note: Kinds of account are settings too. Default daily limit:
checks.title: Acceptance checks
checks.subtitle: A fresh Postgres in this tab, the same migrations, a small fixture: every rule tested the way an attacker or a tired adviser would test it.
checks.starting: Starting a second, empty database and running the migrations…
checks.footer: The same checks run in CI on every pull request (libs/db/src/checks.test.ts). Check titles are test names, so they stay in English.
dash.todo.forward_one: 1 receipt not forwarded to the exchanger
ship.indirect_hint_one: 1 cost, converted on the day it was paid
closing.subtitle_issues_one: 1 of {total} checks needs a look. Contradictions are shown, never smoothed over.
shell.offline_pending_one: No connection. 1 save is on this phone, waiting to be sent.
order.sum.without_blocked: Can't be saved yet. Without the blocked line: {usd}, which is {sdg}.
profit.key.unassigned: Not tied to one (rent, salaries, UAE conversions)
profit.key.unreleased: Paid out before the goods left
closing.lock_why: A closed month can't receive anything dated into it, so its reports stay exactly as they are. Late items go into the open period.
closing.confirm_with_issues: {n} checks still need a look. Close the month anyway?
signin.failed: That email and password did not match.
signin.hosted_note: This is the hosted version: the session comes from Supabase Auth and every rule is enforced by the database.
